title: Morphism-level raw transition comparison
statement: Under the hypotheses of sbc-lem-higher-image-raw-transition-to-hom, the two natural morphisms from the raw presheaf at U to the higher direct image target are equal before applying them to z.

proof.text: Use the raw derived-adjunction comparison, obtained from the existing pullback/single comparison and inverse hom-equivalence naturality, at the shifted coefficient objects. Expand the mate into the canonical lowerStarPlusTransition followed by the coefficient map.

The canonical transition commutes with the homology shift comparison. This is proved by shift compatibility of the derived adjunction unit/counit and pullback-composition comparison, followed by naturality of isoShiftZero and shiftIso.

Evaluate higherDirectImagePresheafToHom with its existing app_apply formula. Apply degree-zero homology to the adjunct equality, use the previous shift identity, and reassociate. Extensionality gives the original morphism equality; no hypotheses or definitions change.

lean.statement: theorem higherDirectImageRawTransition_toHom_core (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {Y Y' S : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ S) (h' : Y' ⟶ S) (w : a ≫ h = h') (q : ℤ) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) (K' : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) (v : D+((a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj K ⟶ K') (U : S.Etale) : (higherDirectImagePresheafToHom Λ h' q K').app (op U) ∘ (higherDirectImageRawTrianglePullback Λ a h h' w q K K' v U) = (higherDirectImagePresheafToHom Λ h q K).app (op U) ≫ (Functor.whiskerLeft (freeSheaf Λ S).op (preadditiveYoneda.map ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).map (lowerStarPlusTransition Λ a h h' w K ≫ R+((h')_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map v)))).app (op U)
